description: Calculates a BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny, 八字, 四柱推命, Saju) chart from a birth date, time and place with the InsightBaZi engine, and shows it as a chart card. Use it when the user asks for a BaZi chart, or for their Four Pillars, Day Master, Ten Gods, element balance or 10-year luck pillars to be worked out from a birth date. It applies true solar time from the birthplace longitude and historical daylight-saving rules, changes the Day Pillar at 23:00, the year at Lichun and months at solar terms. The chart card is the user-facing result. After a chart-only request, briefly confirm it is ready; do not duplicate its chart, tables or element breakdown. Interpret the structured result only if requested, or provide a text chart if explicitly requested.

birth_date.description: Birth date in the Gregorian calendar, YYYY-MM-DD.

birth_time.description: Clock time on the birth record, 24-hour HH:MM, exactly as recorded (do not adjust for daylight saving). Omit when the user does not know it.

birthplace.description: Birth city as the user gave it, shown on the card. This is the place of birth, never the user's current location.

gender.description: Needed only for the 10-year luck pillars, whose direction depends on it.

language.description: Language for chart labels. Use the closest match to the user's language; use en when none matches.

longitude.description: Longitude of the birth city in decimal degrees, east positive, used only for the true-solar-time correction. Give the city's longitude when the birth city is known; never the user's current location.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, for example Asia/Bangkok or America/New_York.

name: calculate_bazi_chart
title: Calculate BaZi chart
